C0576.title: Luoyang Hundred-Million-Yuan Order-Brushing False Advertising Case
C0576.summary: In July 2025, the Supreme People's Procuratorate disclosed an order-brushing and fake-review case handled by the Luoyang High-Tech Zone Procuratorate. Five defendants, including Zhang and Ye, operated order-brushing platforms such as Taojingling and Jifeng, organizing workers to conduct fake transactions and positive reviews across multiple e-commerce platforms. The case involved more than 150 million yuan in merchandise principal and over 5.41 million yuan in illegal gains. The court adopted the procuratorate's charges and sentencing recommendations and convicted the five defendants of false advertising, imposing imprisonment or suspended sentences and fines.
